text:
alex: hi all, excited to land my first PR to infra-agent. quick onboarding q's: should i branch from main or from the long-running infra/dev branch? also accidentally committed some build outputs — how do i clean that up without losing my changes?

priya: welcome alex :wave: branch from main for small fixes/features. feature/<ticket>-shortdesc for anything non-trivial. infra/dev is used for large coordinated rollouts.

ben: on generated/build files: don't commit them. easiest fix: reset those files to upstream and recommit only your source changes. e.g. 
```bash
git fetch origin
# restore generated files from main so they are removed from your branch commits
git checkout origin/main -- path/to/generated/*
# re-add only intended files
git add path/to/src/*.go path/to/protos/*.proto
git commit -m "feat(infra-agent): add foo handler (#789)"
```
You can force-push the cleaned branch.

alex: thanks. is there a team-specific commit message convention beyond conventional commits?

maya: we follow conventional commits but include the ticket in parentheses and a short body. example: 

"fix(infra-agent): handle retry logic (ENG-789)"

"Why: avoid double-send during transient failures"

Also when you touch proto definitions, add a note about regeneration in the PR description.

priya: CI will run gen steps and fail if generated artifacts aren't in sync. when CI fails with a gofmt/proto-gen mismatch, regenerate locally with `make gen` and ensure only the source proto changes are committed.

ci-bot: ci-bot: build #3001  FAILED  proto-gen mismatch: proto/gen/agent.pb.go

alex: oh that happened. i reverted the gen files and pushed. should i include a note in the PR checklist about "ran make gen locally"?

ben: yes add a short QA checklist in the PR body: what you changed, how to test locally, and a line "ran make gen; no generated diffs committed". For UI/UX changes add screenshots.

maya: reviewers: add at least one from CODEOWNERS and one from the infra team. small PRs get 48hr SLA, but typically reviewed faster. If you need quick unblock, ping in #eng-oncall.

alex: any pre-commit hooks i should run? got a lint error earlier.

priya: run `make fmt` and `make lint` locally. Husky runs some checks but sometimes CI catches more. If lint autofix changes many files, split formatting into a separate PR.

ci-bot: ci-bot: build #3002  queued

ben: merge policy: squash & merge by default. if you have clean, descriptive separate commits and want to keep them, note in the PR and ask for no-squash. Backports: use release branches naming in PR description if relevant.

alex: perfect, thanks y'all. i'll update the PR body with the checklist and ping when CI is green. appreciate the fast help!
